paper_metadata.title: Effect of Ta additions on microstructure and mechanical properties of a single-crystal Co–Al–W-base alloy

evidence.quote: Microstructures and mechanical properties of Co – 9.5Al– 5W– 16Ni– 6Cr– xTa (at% where x¼ 0, 1.8, 2.8, named as 0Ta, 1.8Ta and 2.8Ta) alloys are investigated.

The master alloys were melted in a vacuum induction furnace
directionally solidiﬁed into [0 0 1] single crystal rods at a constant withdraw rate of 6 mm/min in Bridgeman type furnace
All single crystal rods were homogenized at 1300 1C for 8 h in a vacuum, followed by furnace cooling
then annealed at 850 1C, 950 1C and 10 0 01C for 36 h for 0Ta, 1.8Ta and 2.8Ta, respectively
After that, all samples were annealed at 750 1C for 24 h

After heat treatments, the three alloys are only constituted of γ and cubical γ0 precipitates.
